**Programme year:** 2026

## Santiago, the Pacific coast and Rapa Nui culture

The first days of the route take you through central Chile. You will see historic and modern Santiago, then travel past olive groves, orchards and vineyards in the Curacaví and Casablanca valleys to Valparaíso and Viña del Mar.

The main part of the trip is Easter Island. Here the programme focuses on Rapa Nui culture: Rano Raraku, Ahu Tongariki, Anakena, Orongo, Rano Kau, Ahu Akivi and Puna Pau.
